description: bela is a collection of Pure Data abstractions for working with Bela hardware, providing convenient objects for audio, analog and digital I/O, audio-file playback, and oscilloscope access.

research.notes: An official Bela maintainer identifies this repository as the source of the Deken-installable abstractions used with the bela/ namespace. This distinguishes it from the separate older Bela.pd library at jarmitage/bela.pd.
